long_term_logic.path_frame: Path C with Path A undertone

year_1.label: Foundation Year
year_1.primary_objective: Close muscular endurance and strength gap, foot durability, reintroduce threshold work

year_2.label: Capacity Year
year_2.primary_objective: Build volume tolerance for UTMB-distance training; first properly-trained 100K

year_3.label: UTMB Preparation Year
year_3.primary_objective: Complete 100M qualifier and prepare for UTMB 100M lottery start

sub_phases.name: Recovery Transition
sub_phases.primary_goal: OMD recovery, launch foot protocol, reintroduce bodyweight strength
sub_phases.constraints: All runs Z1 capped at 140 bpm; no quality sessions

sub_phases.name: Max Strength Block
sub_phases.primary_goal: Develop maximum strength and validate foot durability
quality_sessions: Thursday: hill sprints (6–12 x 10s max uphill, 2–3 min walk down)
Saturday: long run at AeT with progressive duration and vert

sub_phases.name: Muscular Endurance + Threshold
sub_phases.primary_goal: Convert max strength to ultra-specific ME and reintroduce Z3–Z4 threshold
quality_sessions: Saturday: uphill/flat combo long run with race kit and fueling practice

heat_block.description: 2–3 sessions/week in late afternoon (16:00–18:00) at race-like temperatures

sub_phases.name: DUT-Specific Taper
sub_phases.notes: Strength removed in later taper; race-pace simulation; carb load in final 3 days

sub_phases.name: Post-DUT Recovery + Winter Base Start
sub_phases.primary_goal: Full recovery then return to base structure and winter aerobic block
sub_phases.notes: Gradual reintroduction of strength; long run returns to 2h Z1 by early November

Thu.description: Easy run in base weeks; hill sprints or threshold in A2/A3

Fri.description: Short Z1 run with strides or rest

Sat.description: Highest volume day; progressive duration and vert

Sun.description: Recovery run + strength B in non-taper weeks

phases.focus: Movement patterns, low load before gym

rules: Add weight OR volume each week, never both
Peak loads in weeks 5–6, deload week 7, test/maintain week 8

phases.focus: Higher reps, sport-specific movements (goblet squats, weighted step-ups, hill bounding)
Reduce and then remove strength before race
phases.pattern: No strength in late taper; bodyweight only in early post-race

setup.documentation: Log shoes, socks, lubricant, hotspots, and post-run photos for every long run ≥2h

testing_phase.goal: Lock race sock + lube + lacing combo
testing_phase.escalation: If lateral heel friction persists by July 12, test alternative shoes (e.g. Speedgoat, S/Lab Genesis, Speedland)

validation_run.description: 4h long run on technical descent terrain in full race kit; clean feet = protocol confirmed

steps: Apply Leukotape P to lateral heels (alcohol prep first)
Apply lubricant over tape and surrounding skin
Stop immediately at any hotspot during race

sub_phases.name: Post-DUT easy base
sub_phases.focus: Easy aerobic only; light strength returns
sub_phases.notes: Transition from A5 into winter base

sub_phases.name: Pure aerobic base + max strength
sub_phases.focus: All runs Z1 except club; new max strength block heavier than autumn
sub_phases.targets: Average 55–65 km/week, peak ~75 km/week in late January

sub_phases.name: Aerobic depth + threshold reintroduction
sub_phases.focus: Long runs 32–35km, low effort; light threshold 1x/week; possible half-marathon benchmark race late Feb/early Mar

plans.label: First Stones-Eligible Race Block
focus: Heat block and full nutrition rehearsal

plans.label: Portuguese Trail Running Ligue Season & January 2026 Foundation
plans.season_calendar_notes: Strategic race calendar and ATRP season architecture; multiple referenced races in PT with links.

context.purpose: Re-entry, rebuild aerobic base toward 2026 calendar

january_2026_block.structure_note: Week-by-week January schedule is defined in the source file and can be mapped into the same weekly_template structure as the DUT block.
